title: Untitled (Freestyle)
altText: Freestyle biomorphic graffiti mural by Mr Blob Art for 167/B Street, integrating a complex wildstyle lettering spelling BLOB into a surreal organic creature on a curved street wall.
description:
Produced entirely freestyle for the 167/B Street public art project in Lecce, this site-specific mural was conceptualized and developed freehand directly on-site, naturally adapting to the curved architectural surface to generate a sense of hypnotic movement.

The dynamic composition showcases a total deconstruction of classic graffiti lettering: the letters spelling out the word "BLOB" blend and evolve into a complex, tentacled bio-organic entity, resembling a mutating marine or alien organism. The piece is characterized by zebra-like patterns and psychedelic veins, where warm tones (orange, gold, and purple) clash with highly luminous cyan and acid green accents.
